summary.text: Wancito Francius is the Republican candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 108 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Daphne Campbell in a race with no incumbent.
Born in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, he describes his profession on Ballotpedia as activist.

paragraphs.text: Wancito Francius was born in Port-au-Prince, Haiti.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the State University of Haiti in 2003, an associate degree from Miami Dade College in 2012 and a bachelor's degree from Florida International University in 2015.
His career experience includes working as an activist, and Ballotpedia lists his religion as Baptist.

Francius previously ran as a Democrat in primaries for Florida House District 107, losing to incumbent Christopher Benjamin in 2022 with 18.7% of the vote and finishing with 6.6% in the 2024 primary won by Wallace Aristide.
In 2026 he advanced from the Republican primary for District 108 after it was canceled.
